articles.summary: Due to Hurricane Lowell, Bank of Hawai‘i will temporarily close all branch operations and offices on Kaua‘i tomorrow, Tuesday, Sept. 8, and will remain closed until further notice.
articles.title: Bank of Hawai‘i to Temporarily Close Branches and Offices on Kaua‘i Due to Hurricane Lowell
